available_evidence_audit.distinction_from_e1: The application has structural evidence, but no current requirement maps to a registered deterministic policy that consumes enough of it. This is not an E1 routing gap.

airflow_path.current_inventory: not one of the eleven current E records; remains a separate B4 hard requirement in adapter-coupler-002
airflow_path.assessment: Topology validity, volume, shell count, and a cavity do not prove a continuous airflow passage. A trustworthy test would need an explicitly scoped passage/opening definition and an authoritative geometric path analysis. Do not infer flow performance from volume or generic openings.

opening_and_feature_presence.assessment: Existing mesh opening/feature policies accept structured expectations, but current E records lack the required interface-specific shape, size, location, or output declarations. STL candidate holes are explicitly non-authoritative where physical-hole proof is required. No general feature detector should be revived from this report.

connection_and_mating_diameter.assessment: The 35 mm hose diameter is the strongest E2 candidate. A narrow analytic B-Rep cylindrical-opening measurement could be generic if it verifies the correct interface and reports tolerance/axis/ambiguity. The current code does not persist that evidence. Proprietary Dyson compatibility remains E3.

clearance.assessment: Explicit numeric clearance remains machine-required. Existing cross-output clearance is not applicable to the single-output M4-head claim. ‘Typical M4’ lacks authoritative head dimensions and tolerance, so the current blocker is primarily specification/mating-data E3; only after those facts exist should a local B-Rep clearance verifier be considered E2.

fit_and_compatibility.assessment: Instrument, battery, trimmer, Dyson, and folio-case compatibility require authoritative external envelope/interface facts. Product names and provider prose are not geometry evidence.

structural_relationships.assessment: Output-to-output relationships can use existing named-output cross-output policies when both outputs and expectations are explicit. None of the current eleven has such a complete contract. External-object relationships remain E3; static stability remains E4.

geometry_failure_cases.note: No current E requirement has persisted PASS/FAIL evidence proving that generated geometry is objectively absent or wrong. container-case-002 has a historically proven missing lid, but it is a Recovery-C2 geometry omission outside the current eleven and remains separately blocked.
